column1: # The shell list (tools/build/lint/shell_budget.bzl): every shell script of the
# repository that remains, by path, and why it is still shell. A new shell script
# fails the build until it has a row; a row whose script is deleted (or is no
# longer shell) fails until the row is removed, so the list only shrinks. Editing
# a listed script never touches this file. A new row needs a reason review accepts.
